<?php
$o = new class {
    public function __isset(string $name): bool {
        echo "I:", $name, ";";
        return $name === "yes";
    }
};
$name = "no";
echo ($o->{$name} ?? 9) === 9 ? "FALL;" : "BAD;";
$name = "yes";
echo ($o->{$name} ?? 9) === 9 ? "FALL;" : "BAD;";

<?php
$o = new class {
    public function __isset(string $name): bool {
        echo "I:", $name, ";";
        return $name === "yes";
    }
    public function __get($name) { echo "GET:", $name, ";"; return 0; }
};
$no = "no";
$yes = "yes";
echo ($o->{$no} ?? 9) === 9 ? "FALL;" : "BAD;";
echo ($o->{$yes} ?? 9) === 0 ? "ZERO;" : "BAD;";
